messages:
julia: customer ACME (ticket #1578) reporting dashboard 'Delivery Metrics' missing the 'impressions' series on mobile. Desktop looks fine. They also see tooltips showing wrong totals (e.g., tooltip shows 0 while raw API returns 18). Happening since ~2026-03-12 14:20 UTC. Escalating.

mike: :eyes: can you paste browser/user agent + screenshot? is this iOS Safari only?

julia: attached screenshot.png, user agent: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 16_3 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/... Safari/16.3. Sentry ID: sentry-bot: 9f2c4b. Also saw a bunch of 502 from metrics-ingest around 2026-03-12T14:18Z.

priya: seeing ingestion backpressure at that time — jobs backlog spiked on collector-redis. Ran: kubectl -n metrics exec -it collector-0 -- redis-cli LLEN work:ingest -> 24000. We had a quick retry storm from batch window. Might have dropped series index for short window.

anchal: frontend deploy at 2026-03-12T14:15 (commit 3a7b2f4) included a small CSS change to legend layout; suspect flex wrap regressed in narrow viewport. Repro on iPhone 12 emulator with viewport 390x844: legend items collapse and overlap tooltips offset.

mike: confirmed locally — CSS change sets .legend {display:flex;flex-wrap:nowrap} which causes overflow-hidden on parent. Quick test: reverting to flex-wrap:wrap fixes alignment. I'll open a small revert PR.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: PR #432 revert-legend-wrap -> target: canary -> commit 3a7b2f4-revert

priya: for missing series (metrics), we can backfill from raw events. I started a backfill job for ACME for 2026-03-12T14:00-15:00. ETA ~2h depending on throughput.

mike: rolled out canary patch to 10% at 2026-03-12T15:00 UTC. Observed tooltips realign on mobile. :thumbsup:

julia: customer notified with workaround (use desktop or toggle 'compact view'), they accepted canary patch testing. Ticket updated.

priya: backfill completed at 2026-03-12T17:12 UTC, series restored. No data lost beyond that window. Looking into rate-limiting of ingest retries to prevent backlog.

anchal: will add an e2e mobile legend test in CI and prevent CSS regressions. Follow-up: create a postmortem doc in #incidents.

julia: marking ticket ready to close, will confirm with customer tomorrow. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
